claims.assertion: Swaruu (9) says portals form when changing gravitational-frequency harmonics briefly make two locations equivalent; the opening lasts only while that pattern holds.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)

claims.assertion: She says natural portals range from tiny, frequent bubbles to larger passages; many recur predictably at energetic nodes, and eclipses can trigger them.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)
claims.qualifiers: She says many, but not all, are predictable.

claims.assertion: Swaruu says passage can lead to compatible places or times, with return possible while a portal remains open; spacefarers favor supraluminal flight to avoid portals.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)
